facts.claim: Pages publication changes did not require instance reconciliation
Pages and validation succeeded after trigger scopes were narrowed

context.objective: Reduce redundant CI without weakening runtime validation

abstain_when: Changed paths affect runtime, release, policy or reconciliation contracts
recommendation.action: Keep pull-request validation complete and exclude documentation-only main pushes from runtime-oriented checks.
alternatives: Run the complete pipeline for every push
recommendation.rationale: The observed publication change had an independent Pages outcome and did not exercise runtime authority; path-scoped main validation preserved the checks for runtime contracts.

constraints: Historical PRs may not have had contemporaneous Issues

facts.claim: A single archive Issue obscured distinct repository evolution
Specific Issue and Project associations made work readable across repositories

context.objective: Make project history useful to humans and models

abstain_when: The historical intent cannot be inferred from source evidence
recommendation.action: Associate new PRs with specific closing Issues and native Projects; reconstruct historical groups only when evidence supports the grouping.
alternatives: Put every historical PR into one archive Issue
Invent retrospective intent for unclear changes
recommendation.rationale: Specific work items preserve purpose and sequence, while an explicit abstention prevents fabricated historical context.
